scope: Event-by-event path audit of the 54 current small-aperture W2 pre-veto events and 52 final events, with an exposure-matched comparison to the old large-aperture 35x35-grid campaign.

classification_rules.coordinate_transform: All IA INIT directions and IA positions are inverse-rotated by the InstrumentFrame Rotation 0 45 0 into the instrument-local frame.
classification_rules.first_interaction: The first non-INIT IA record is recovered from each raw SIM event. A TES first interaction means no prior simulated interaction; a BGO RAYL first interaction is an elastic BGO scatter.
classification_rules.uninteracted_transmission: For TES-first events, the INIT-to-first-IA segment is tested against the BGO solids at 0.002 cm midpoint resolution. The component with the longest crossed path labels mixed side/rear crossings.
classification_rules.w_grid: All 624 W bar BRIK placements are parsed from the frozen geometry and intersected analytically with each INIT-to-first-IA ray.
classification_rules.front_square_direct: TES-first, no BGO intersection, forward optical-axis direction, and projection at x=-44.7 within the current +/-1.898 cm square. This label does not imply an empty W channel; W path is recorded separately.
classification_rules.rear_cold_port_direct: TES-first, no BGO intersection, reverse optical-axis direction, and projection through the rear r<0.75 cm cold port.
classification_rules.old_new_aperture_region_comparison: TES-first forward events projected at x=-44.7. Retained region is inside +/-1.898 cm; removed region is inside the old +/-3.0 cm square but outside the retained square.

old_large_aperture_comparator.note: The old 151-event comparator was independently parsed from all 64 raw SIM shards using the same INIT/first-IA convention. Its compact event list is not duplicated here; hashes freeze the source catalog.

input_integrity.current_sim_output_digest_policy: No full SIM hashes were computed, matching the frozen campaign PATH_SIZE_HEADER_ONLY__NO_FULL_SIM_HASH policy. All 21 paths, sizes, geometry headers, seeds, event totals, and exposure are closed by TRANSPORT_VALIDATION.json.

interpretation.evidence: The specifically removed aperture-region component falls from 21/8339.8231 s to 2/2654.3379 s, a 70.1% reduction, but it represented only 13.9% of the old final leakage. Most selected events are side, rear, high-obliquity, uncollided shield transmissions, or zero-deposit BGO Rayleigh scatters.
interpretation.correction: BGO deposit equal to zero does not mean that a photon avoided BGO. It can traverse BGO without an interaction or Rayleigh-scatter with negligible energy transfer.
interpretation.conclusion: The total mono-line rate is not expected to scale with front-window area. The old and new total rates differ by only 0.48 combined Poisson sigma. The SH3-versus-SG3 line-performance gap therefore cannot be assigned primarily to the old SH3 front opening from these data; full 4pi side/rear transport and shield coupling must be compared.

limitations: This is a prompt monoenergetic transport path audit, not an activation study.
BGO path lengths use 0.002 cm midpoint membership sampling; W boxes use exact ray-box intersections.
The SG3 3M raw SIM volume was unavailable through the failing /mnt/data mount, so no matched SG3 event-path decomposition is claimed.
The SG3 line result has only 12 final events and 28.9% relative Monte Carlo uncertainty.
